# TaskNexus

TaskNexus is a collaboration platform for task delivery, teams, projects,
hackathons, evidence-backed portfolios, and early-career opportunities.

Public pages may be indexed. Authenticated workspaces, applications, team
settings, organization workspaces, and other private routes must not be indexed.

- Site: https://task-nexus-official.vercel.app/
- Opportunities: https://task-nexus-official.vercel.app/opportunities
- Hackathons: https://task-nexus-official.vercel.app/hackathons
